description.text: Program Description The students mainly study the basic theory and basic knowledge of law, by thinking of law and legal practice of basic training, has the use of legal theory and method to analyze and apply law affairs management and the basic ability to solve the problem. Internship Main practical teaching links: including internship, legal consultation, social investigation, thematic debate, simulated trial, suspect debate, practice, etc., generally no less than 20 weeks. Duration 4 years

duration.text: The Law Science at Beijing Jiaotong University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3055 USD/per year ￥ 22000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 6. Financial guarantee letter Photocopy of the signatured financial guarantee letter from his/her financial guarantor to prove their solvency.

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 2. High school graduate Be in good health condition and above the age of 18
